scenes.text: Imagine holding a simple glass teardrop in your hand that is so incredibly strong it can literally shatter a speeding bullet on impact, which is known as a Prince Rupert's Drop.

By dropping red-hot molten glass directly into freezing cold water, the outer shell cools instantly and shrinks, squeezing the molten inside with an absolutely unimaginable amount of physical pressure.

This high-tension state makes the bulb end practically indestructible against heavy hammers and high-caliber bullets, but if you apply just a tiny pinch of pressure to its delicate tail, the entire structure instantly explodes into powder.
This explosive shockwave travels through the glass faster than a speeding bullet, so tell us in the comments if you would dare to hold one of these, and follow for more science secrets!
